title: Do not call even denominators an escape while preserving independent limiting terms
statement: If the reduced rank-one term tensors are linearly independent, normalization of each projective factor forces every term valuation nonnegative and its residue coefficient one. It therefore reduces a fraction-field decomposition with those projective limits to the forbidden integral case. The supplied47terms have exact binary rank47. This excludes that point/orbit, not dependent bad-reduction boundaries or different algorithms.
